findings.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN CVE-2026-20182 — Talos UAT-8616 attribution + Rapid7 technical writeup; federal deadline 2026-05-17
findings.affected_technology: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller / Manager (on-prem + SD-WAN Cloud)
findings.summary: Rapid7 published a full technical writeup of the SD-WAN peering-authentication bypass; Talos / SecurityWeek tied it to UAT-8616 and frame this as the sixth Cisco-perimeter exploited zero-day of 2026, with CISA KEV federal deadline 2026-05-17 (<36h from now).

findings.title: Mini Shai-Hulud Wave 2 worm source code publicly released by TeamPCP on BreachForums
findings.affected_technology: npm + PyPI publishing infrastructure (TanStack / UiPath / Mistral / OpenAI publisher chain)
findings.summary: TeamPCP released the full Wave 2 worm source code (pull_request_target chain, GitHub Actions cache poisoning, OIDC token theft, orphaned-commit optional-dependency propagation) one day after the $1,000 BreachForums supply-chain contest, converting the worm primitive into commodity tooling.

findings.title: Microsoft Exchange Server CVE-2026-42897 — active exploitation confirmed; mitigations only, no permanent patch yet
findings.summary: Microsoft confirmed in-the-wild exploitation of CVE-2026-42897 OWA XSS-via-crafted-email; the company has issued interim mitigations but no permanent patch yet, and the bug chains cleanly with the on-prem Exchange PRC initial-access vector active across 2026-Q2.

findings.title: Linux Copy Fail CVE-2026-31431 — Kubernetes container escape PoC published; LPE now a node-compromise primitive
findings.affected_technology: Linux kernel page-cache subsystem (Ubuntu / RHEL / SUSE / Debian / Amazon Linux); Kubernetes nodes
findings.summary: New public PoC Percivalll/Copy-Fail-CVE-2026-31431-Kubernetes-PoC converts the Copy Fail kernel page-cache write into a container escape from an unprivileged Kubernetes pod to node-level code execution, broadening the bug from LPE-only to container-escape-class.

findings.title: Funnel Builder WordPress plugin — unauthenticated settings modification → active payment-card skimmer campaign on WooCommerce sites
findings.affected_technology: Funnel Builder by FunnelKit WordPress plugin ≤ 3.15.0.2 (~40,000 active installs); WooCommerce checkout
findings.summary: Sansec confirmed active mass exploitation of an unauthenticated settings-modification bug allowing injection of fake-Google-Analytics JavaScript that loads a WebSocket-relayed payment-card skimmer on checkout pages; vendor shipped 3.15.0.3 on 2026-05-14.

findings.title: Avada Builder WordPress plugin CVE-2026-4798 unauth SQL injection (+ CVE-2026-4782 auth file read) — 1M installs
findings.affected_technology: Avada Builder WordPress plugin ≤ 3.15.2 (~1,000,000 active installs)
findings.summary: Time-based blind unauth SQL injection in product_order parameter (when WooCommerce was previously installed then deactivated with residual tables) plus authenticated arbitrary-file-read via custom_svg shortcode allows full site takeover via wp-config.php exfiltration; fixed in 3.15.3 (2026-05-12).

findings.title: n8n 3-CVE batch — HTTP Request pagination prototype-pollution RCE (CVE-2026-44789), Git Node arbitrary file read (CVE-2026-44790), XML Node prototype-pollution patch bypass (CVE-2026-44791)
findings.affected_technology: n8n self-hosted workflow automation (npm n8n) — pre-patched 1.x releases
findings.summary: GHSA-published 3-CVE critical batch on n8n: HTTP Request node prototype-pollution → RCE on host, Git Node arbitrary file read, and patch-bypass on a prior XML Node prototype-pollution via attribute-namespace polluted keys — second critical n8n RCE batch in 2026 after March's CVE-2026-21858.

findings.title: Portainer CVE-2026-44848 missing-authz Docker plugin → host RCE + CVE-2026-44849 Swarm endpoint security bypass
findings.affected_technology: Portainer Community Edition + Business Edition (Go) — pre-patched 2.x releases
findings.summary: Any authenticated Portainer user (regardless of role) can install Docker plugins on any managed host via missing-authz on plugin management endpoints, yielding host-level RCE on every Docker host managed by the Portainer instance; companion Swarm-service security-bypass.

findings.title: Amazon Redshift JDBC driver CVE-2026-8178 — RCE via unsafe class loading in redshift-jdbc42
findings.affected_technology: com.amazon.redshift:redshift-jdbc42 (Maven) — affecting BI tools, application servers, data-pipeline runners, analyst notebooks
findings.summary: Unsafe class loading in the Redshift JDBC driver allows a malicious JDBC connection string to coerce the driver into loading attacker-controlled JVM classes, yielding RCE in the JVM process loading the driver — affecting every Redshift-connected JVM environment.

findings.title: OpenClaw 3-CVE OpenShell sandbox race-condition chain — sandbox escape, data exfiltration, persistence
findings.summary: Time-of-check / time-of-use race condition in OpenShell sandbox input validation chained with incomplete-validation data-exfiltration and persistence primitives — adds to the 35+ OpenClaw CVEs disclosed in 2026, particularly impactful for stale OpenClaw 2026.2.x deployments documented in MEMORY.

findings.title: Pwn2Own Berlin 2026 Day 2 — 15 additional zero-days including Microsoft Exchange compromise; $385,750 awarded; two-day total $908,750
findings.affected_technology: Microsoft Exchange Server, Windows 11, additional virtualisation and enterprise targets
findings.summary: Day 2 of Pwn2Own Berlin produced 15 more zero-day demonstrations including a Microsoft Exchange compromise on the same day Microsoft confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-42897 — chains under ZDI embargo pending vendor coordination.

noted.summary: Logic bug in __ptrace_may_access() with public PoC _SiCk/ssh-keysign-pwn; LPE only, no CVE assigned at disclosure; track for promotion if KEV-added or chained.
RCE via SQL injection in code generation in Flink SQL Gateway; stream-processing framework widely deployed in enterprise data pipelines; limited technical detail at disclosure.
Push-mode APNG parser chunk smuggling; downstream distribution impact across widely-bundled library; client-side parsing path.
20-CVE security release on Apple Filing Protocol implementation; affects NAS appliances and Time Machine targets; 18 issues deferred. Out of typical perimeter scope.
Multi-CVE PostgreSQL security release; specific CVE list pending; apply via OS package channels.
Critical default XSS via xmp raw-text passthrough in sanitize-html (~2M weekly downloads); affects any application using default config to sanitize untrusted HTML.
Sensitive-data leak via relational filtering without query sanitization; companion to CVE-2026-22599 from 2026-05-13.
Remote code injection in dynamic table expressions; niche but in-scope where embedded in GIS web stacks.
Unauthenticated Solr Streaming Expression proxy on digital-library / museum-collection software; SSRF / data extraction primitive.
Authorization bypass on /mcp-connect/{id} — any authenticated user can connect to any registered MCP server; continues the MCP-server authz/authn pattern (8+ MCP issues in MEMORY).
Authenticated host RCE via NodeVM sandbox escape on /api/v1/node-custom-function — Flowise's typical default-no-auth posture per MEMORY makes this exploitable in many deployments.
Unsafe unicode handling in CGI path splitting allowing execution of non-PHP files; sub-cluster of the Apache HTTP / PHP-FPM path-splitting class.
3-CVE batch on Budibase low-code platform — datasource authz, SSRF redirect bypass, SSRF in AI Extract File via missing IP blacklist.
OS command injection in on_publish.php execAsync via unescaped m3u8 URL parameter; live-streaming platform; companion passwordless admin issue in Meet plugin.
Rate-limiter keys individual IPv6 addresses; bypassable via 2^64 prefix-rotation space; authentication library.
Path traversal in /files endpoint enabling arbitrary file read; AI voice-agent framework.
Authenticated users can download unrelated Laravel Storage objects; Laravel admin panel cross-Storage data exposure.
Unsafe bookmark operation when clicking local-type bookmark; fourth electerm CVE in 30 days — deprecation-candidate cluster signal.
Path traversal allowing out-of-ticket-directory read/unserialize chain on federated SSO server library.
WWW::Mechanize::Cached deserialization, Imager::File::GIF heap OOB (×2), Apache::Session SHA256 weak ID, Trog::TOTP weak random, Crypt::DSA weak seed and file write — niche Perl modules.
Multiple vulnerabilities in llama.cpp GGUF model-file parsers; AI inference engine widely deployed self-hosted; pending CVE assignment.
Critical auth-bypass patched in MOVEit Automation; no public exploit yet, but MOVEit's 2023 supply-chain history makes any auth-bypass a high-priority patch candidate.
Belarus-aligned APT resumed campaigns active since March 2026 with geofenced PDF phishing delivering PicassoLoader + Cobalt Strike against Ukrainian government targets.
FSB-aligned Russian APT upgraded Kazuar backdoor to peer-to-peer botnet for stealth + persistent network access; APT-tier IOC pattern, not a vulnerability.
Deep-dive analysis follow-up on CVE-2026-34197 Jolokia RCE; confirms ~7,000 internet-exposed instances; analytical post, no new tempo signal.
Ransomware breach disclosed nearly a year after the attack; financial-services PII exposure; no novel TTP.
January 2026 healthcare breach disclosure; standard healthcare PII exfiltration.
Industry consolidation — LayerX is the Claude-for-Chrome / ClaudeBleed disclosure org (MEMORY 2026-05-09); track for any disclosure-policy change post-acquisition.
G7 released AI supply-chain transparency guidance; relevant for AI-platform vendors' future compliance posture.
Microsoft will stop loading saved passwords into Edge memory at startup; operational hardening, not a vulnerability.
From the Mini Shai-Hulud Wave 2 OpenAI breach: users of OpenAI macOS / Windows / iOS / Android apps must update by 2026-06-12 to maintain code-signing chain.
